newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Dawn Fraser in hospital after chest pains.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Dawn Fraser in hospital after chest pains.

text.p: Former Australian swimming great Dawn Fraser was resting comfortably on Tuesday after being admitted to hospital suffering chest pains.
The four-times Olympic gold medalist admitted herself to hospital in the southern New South Wales town of Griffith on Saturday and was flown to Sydney on Tuesday for further tests.
She is undergoing some tests and is now resting comfortably," a spokeswoman for her publicists said.
Fraser, 59, and Olympic 100 metres freestyle champion in 1956, 1960 and 1964, also won an Olympic relay gold.
She spent three days in hospital in Atlanta during the Olympic Games earlier this year after suffering an angina attack.
